title: Product Lead - AI
jobDescription: At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. Key Responsibilities Oversight & Best Practices: Optimize product management processes, employing AI where possible and proactively identify areas for standardization and improved efficiency (e.g. Service Descriptions), document and implement. Roadmap Support: Oversee process for product managers in developing and managing roadmaps; coordinating feedback for process improvements, and preparing client and senior management-ready roadmap views near on-demand. Governance Coordination: Support execution of annual Wealth Investment Governance Board by defining and coordinating PM driven templates, supporting content creation, execute logistics and run of show and following up on actions. Strategic Support: Opportunity to contribute to ad hoc strategic client or internal projects and initiatives as directed by Senior Management, such as documentation and coordination across product for Strat Planning, Growth Day and Client Sales Opportunities. AI: Assist teams in utilizing BR AI tools to capture valuable product insights that support their strategies and client adoption. Contributing to and supporting the Wealth AI task force, and ideating on new innovations to support the COE and managing reporting and metrics. What Success Looks Like: Implemented Service Description workflow and attestation process, including coordinated legal updates and tracking of common elements. Ability to produce on-demand roadmaps by product or Wealth overall as required both from clients and internally Efficiently executed internal events that impact and advance our strategic Wealth initiatives, providing clear actions and follow ups with stakeholders and clients. Become a Go-To Product COE expert in support of our Product teams, ensuring their success in delivering high quality roadmaps, ideas and processes. Delivery of well documented processes and best practices available to all associates, maintained and updated consistently AI driven process ideation and implementation of our product management process, creating efficiencies and best practices adopted across the COE. We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective. Use of AI in Hiring As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration. Broadridge Financial Solutions (NYSE: BR) is a global technology leader with trusted expertise and transformative technology, helping clients and the financial services industry operate, innovate, and grow. We power investing, governance, and communications for our clients – driving operational resiliency, elevating business performance, and transforming investor experiences. Our technology and operations platforms process and generate over 7 billion communications annually and underpin the daily average trading of over $15 trillion in equities, fixed income, and other securities globally. A certified Great Place to Work®, Broadridge is part of the S&P 500® Index, employing over 15,000 associates in 21 countries. Linked In Facebook Instagram Twitter You Tube Glassdoor The Muse Broadridge is committed to creating an engaging workplace for the most talented associates in our industry. We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and healthy environment that promotes flexibility and accountability. As a leading provider of technology, communications, and data and analytics solutions to businesses around the world, it is critical that we understand, embrace, and operate in a multicultural environment. Every associate has unique strengths, which, when fully appreciated and embraced, allow individuals to perform at their best, leading to our success. We believe that our associates are our most important asset. Encouraging professional development opportunities is a core part of our culture. Broadridge provides educational opportunities, including formal classes, training programs and events. To enable learning in our hybrid working model, Broadridge has redesigned all development programs for 100% virtual delivery. Our associates have access to 8,500+ online courses covering business, leadership, technical, and function-specific topics through our Linked In Learning program.

Assessing business objectives Experience in developing enhancements & troubleshooting issues. Ability to prioritize and work on multiple assignments simultaneously. Very strong communication skills. Strong continuous improvement mind-set. Flexible to work in UK shift. Ensures that system improvements are successfully implemented. title: Senior ETL (Informatica) & SQL Engineer
jobDescription: At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. Key Responsibilities Analyze business and data-aggregation requirements, including source-to-target mappings, transformations, lookups, business rules, and data-quality needs. Design, develop, test, implement, and support Informatica ETL workflows, mappings, sessions, transformations, and scheduling processes. Develop extract, transform, and load processes to support operational data, reference data, data warehouses, reporting, and analytics environments. Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, database code, and data-processing logic using My SQL and other applicable SQL technologies. Design and enhance physical and logical data models, database tables, relationships, and data structures to support application and reporting requirements. Apply Informatica capabilities such as Workflow Monitor, Scheduler, gp Load, pushdown optimization, and parallelization to improve ETL efficiency and reliability. Establish transformation logic, exception handling, reconciliation processes, and operational controls to promote data accuracy and system performance. Troubleshoot and resolve data issues, ETL failures, slow-running jobs, SQL performance concerns, and production incidents. Translate business requirements into technical designs and specifications; document interfaces, workflows, conversions, reports, and technical solutions. Work closely with database development, application development, QA, client implementation, client support, and business teams throughout the software development lifecycle. Participate in requirements workshops, technical design sessions, code reviews, test planning, and QA/UAT support activities. Provide effort estimates, identify delivery risks and dependencies, and recommend scope or schedule adjustments when appropriate. Follow Broadridge SDLC, security, coding, source-control, and technical standards while delivering high-quality work on schedule. Collaborate with team members, communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders, and support junior associates through established development processes. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered. 5+ years of experience in ETL development, SQL development, database development, application development, or a comparable technical environment. Hands-on Informatica application-development experience, including designing workflows, mappings, sessions, transformations, and lookups. Experience with Informatica performance and operational features, including pushdown optimization, parallelization, gp Load, Workflow Monitor, and Scheduler. Strong SQL development and query-optimization skills, including experience with My SQL. Working knowledge of T-SQL, Postgre SQL, PL/SQL, XML, JSON, and UNIX shell scripting. Experience with ETL techniques, data warehousing, operational data stores, data modeling, data aggregation, and analytical data systems. Experience identifying and resolving ETL and SQL performance issues. Working knowledge of Git or comparable source-code version-control tools. Familiarity with Agile and Waterfall development methodologies, system design, and software delivery practices. Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing data solutions for financial software or the banking, mutual fund, investment accounting, asset management, wealth management, or portfolio-management industries. Experience supporting enterprise data platforms and client-facing applications. Experience facilitating technical workshops and communicating requirements, designs, and issue resolution with users at all organizational levels. Knowledge of additional relational or No SQL technologies, such as Postgre SQL or Mongo DB. Experience with Dev Ops practices, deployment automation, and automated testing for data applications. title: Technology Lead
jobDescription:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. Skill Requirements: Technical Skills Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a technology-related field. 7+ years of experience in Information Security, Application Security, Network Security, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security, Security Engineering, or related technology roles. Working knowledge of WAF technologies, implementation approaches, policy configuration, rule tuning, alert review, false-positive handling, and enforcement modes. Strong understanding of DNS concepts, including domains, subdomains, CNAME records, A records, TTL, propagation, routing changes, domain validation, and DNS cutover planning. Good understanding of web application traffic flows, including HTTP/HTTPS, TLS certificates, reverse proxies, load balancers, CDNs, API gateways, origin servers, and ingress/egress routing. Basic understanding of web application security risks, including OWASP Top 10, injection attacks, cross-site scripting, authentication weaknesses, access control issues, malicious bots, and denial-of-service considerations. Basic understanding of cloud services, cloud networking, cloud security concepts, cloud-hosted application architectures, and cloud-native WAF services such as AWS WAF, Azure Web Application Firewall, Google Cloud Armor, or equivalent services. Familiarity with application hosting models, including on-premises, hybrid, cloud-hosted, Saa S, containerized, and API-based environments. Experience supporting security implementation projects involving application, network, infrastructure, cloud, vendor, and business teams. Familiarity with change management, production cutover planning, rollback planning, deployment validation, and post-implementation monitoring. Ability to review technical documentation, architecture diagrams, traffic flows, DNS records, certificates, WAF logs, rule triggers, and implementation evidence. Experience with Service Now, Jira, Confluence, Share Point, or similar workflow, documentation, and tracking platforms. Ability to create implementation trackers, status dashboards, risk logs, cutover plans, test plans, stakeholder updates, and operational documentation. Soft Skills Strong stakeholder and program management skills, with the ability to work as a collaborative team player while coordinating across applications, infrastructure, network, cloud, DNS, security, vendor, and business teams. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical details, risks, blockers, recommendations, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong ownership, accountability, and organizational skills to drive multiple WAF implementations in parallel from intake through deployment, validation, and closure. Strong problem-solving and influencing skills, with the ability to identify technical dependencies, manage risks, escalate blockers, and keep cross-functional teams aligned toward implementation milestones. Role and

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Drive end-to-end WAF implementation for in-scope applications, websites, APIs, and internet-facing services, including intake, technical discovery, configuration, testing, validation, production cutover, and post-implementation review. Partner with application, infrastructure, network, cloud, DNS, vendor, and Information Security teams to plan and execute WAF onboarding activities. Gather and document key application and environment details, including URLs, domains, subdomains, origin IPs, ports, certificates, traffic patterns, hosting details, ownership, and business criticality. Support DNS and traffic routing activities such as CNAME updates, domain validation, routing changes, cutover planning, rollback planning, and post-change verification. Work with technical teams to understand application architecture, traffic flows, load balancers, CDNs, reverse proxy configurations, cloud hosting models, and related security dependencies. Assist in defining, implementing, testing, and tuning WAF policies, managed rules, custom rules, exclusions, allowlists, blocklists, rate limiting, bot controls, logging, alerting, and enforcement modes. Review WAF alerts, blocked requests, false positives, rule triggers, and traffic patterns during implementation and tuning to ensure effective protection with minimal business impact. Ensure WAF implementations consider application security risks such as OWASP Top 10, authentication flows, APIs, file uploads, business-critical transactions, and user experience impact. Track implementation progress, dependencies, risks, issues, blockers, and completion status across multiple applications or workstreams. Develop and maintain implementation plans, cutover checklists, testing evidence, deployment status, risk summaries, stakeholder updates, and operational documentation. Support change management activities, including change request preparation, deployment communications, rollback steps, implementation windows, and post-implementation validation. Identify and escalate risks such as DNS ownership gaps, certificate issues, incomplete documentation, unsupported traffic flows, application compatibility issues, unclear ownership, or insufficient testing. Provide clear implementation status, risk updates, recommendations, and next steps to management and key stakeholders. Contribute to process improvements, onboarding templates, implementation playbooks, checklists, and repeatable WAF deployment practices Good to Have Experience with WAF platforms, CDN, DDo S protection, bot management, API security, edge security platforms, or cloud-native application protection services such as Akamai, Cloudflare, F5, Imperva, AWS WAF, Azure Web Application Firewall, or Google Cloud Armor. Familiarity with Terraform, infrastructure-as-code, cloud-native deployment practices, TLS certificate management, WAF log analysis, rule tuning, exception handling, and security monitoring. Relevant certifications such as Security+, AWS Cloud Practitioner, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Fundamentals, Azure Security Engineer, CCSP, CCSK, CISSP, or similar certifications; experience in regulated industries such as financial services, banking, capital markets, healthcare, or insurance is a plus. We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective. title: Technical Account Manager
jobDescription: At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. Broadridge Trading & Connectivity Solutions (BTCS) is seeking a customer-focused, technically capable professional to join our Customer Success team. This role is ideal for someone with 3–4 years of experience in the institutional brokerage ecosystem who understands Indian financial markets, trading workflows, and the technology that supports them. As a Customer Success Technical Account Manager, you will serve as a strategic technical partner to clients using Broadridge trading platforms. You will help clients onboard successfully, adopt and optimise platform capabilities, overcome technical challenges, and realise sustained business value from their Broadridge solutions. Key Responsibilities Build trusted, long-term relationships with assigned clients and act as their primary technical advisor. Develop a strong understanding of each client’s business objectives, operating model, trading workflows, and technical environment. Drive adoption, optimisation, and value realisation across Broadridge solutions, identifying opportunities for broader usage and growth. Partner with Customer Success Managers and internal stakeholders to develop and execute account success plans aligned to client priorities. Identify, manage, and help remove technical barriers that may affect adoption, satisfaction, retention, or operational readiness. Advise clients on platform capabilities, integrations, upgrades, solution best practices, and effective usage. Monitor technical account health, proactively identifying risks, trends, service-improvement opportunities, and areas for expansion. Lead regular technical account reviews covering platform performance, current initiatives, roadmap alignment, and recommendations. Coordinate with Product Delivery, Product Management, Engineering, and Support teams to ensure client requirements are understood and addressed effectively. Represent client needs internally by advocating for product enhancements, service improvements, and operational feedback. Support key customer lifecycle events, including onboarding, platform upgrades, change events, expansions, and readiness activities. Deliver training, enablement sessions, demonstrations, and knowledge-sharing activities to improve user confidence and adoption. Build knowledge of Broadridge products and international financial-market workflows, including principal and agency trading, equities, derivatives, and FX. Required Skills & Experience Minimum 3–4 years of relevant experience in the institutional brokerage ecosystem, including hands-on support for trading applications. Good understanding of Indian financial markets, including NSE/BSE, the regulatory landscape, exchange trading, and the end-to-end trade lifecycle. Understanding of institutional order-management workflows, including order entry, modification, cancellation, and execution. Familiarity with trading platforms, Order Management Systems (OMS), and/or Execution Management Systems (EMS). Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both business and technical stakeholders. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritise effectively in a fast-paced, time-sensitive trading environment. Preferred Skills & Experience Experience working with a stockbroker, institutional trading desk, trading technology provider, fintech, or capital-markets firm. Exposure to Indian equities and derivatives markets. Familiarity with FIX connectivity and electronic trading workflows. Experience using AI and productivity tools to improve documentation, reporting, analysis, and routine operational tasks. This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise, client relationship management, and capital-markets knowledge to help clients achieve meaningful outcomes while building deep expertise in Broadridge’s trading and connectivity product suite. We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. title: Product Owner — Reference and Market Data
jobDescription: At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. Key Responsibilities Own, maintain, prioritize, and continuously refine the product backlog in alignment with product strategy, customer needs, business priorities, and roadmap commitments. Partner with the Product Manager to define product vision, strategic objectives, roadmap themes, market opportunities, and success measures. Collaborate closely with Engineering, QA, UX, Data, Architecture, and Operations teams to groom features, clarify requirements, resolve dependencies, and support timely delivery. Translate business objectives and complex financial-market requirements into epics, features, user stories, process flows, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, story elaboration, sprint reviews, product demonstrations, and stakeholder feedback sessions. Ensure user stories are ready for development by defining functional behavior, data attributes, validation rules, exception handling, dependencies, and testable acceptance criteria. Make day-to-day prioritization decisions by balancing customer value, market needs, regulatory requirements, operational risk, technical dependencies, delivery capacity, and time-to-market considerations. Serve as the primary business and functional point of contact for the Scrum team, providing timely clarification and decisions throughout the development lifecycle. Partner with stakeholders to validate delivered functionality, incorporate feedback, and confirm release readiness. Identify and manage product, data, process, and dependency risks; drive appropriate resolution and escalation. Support release planning, stakeholder communications, product documentation, training, and change-management activities. Define and monitor product success measures, including adoption, data quality, user satisfaction, delivery predictability, operational efficiency, and realized business value. Champion continuous improvement in product discovery, backlog quality, Agile practices, delivery processes, and stakeholder collaboration. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Technology, Economics, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience of 7 to 12 years will be considered. Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Product Manager, or similar role supporting financial technology, market data, investment-management, or enterprise financial products. Prior experience in the financial technology sector, with a strong understanding of financial-services workflows, data usage, and client needs. Strong domain knowledge of financial markets, investment products, and reference data, including instrument, issuer, entity, pricing, corporate actions, classifications, identifiers, symbology, and security hierarchies. Working knowledge of financial data from major industry vendors, including Bloomberg, LSEG Data & Analytics (formerly Refinitiv), S&P Global Market Intelligence/Markit, Fact Set, and ICE Data Services. Strong understanding of multiple asset classes, including Equities, Fixed Income, listed and over-the-counter Derivatives, Credit Default Swaps, Credit Indices, Total Return Swaps, and other investment products. Knowledge of reference-data sourcing, vendor data mapping, normalization, enrichment, data lineage, reconciliation, golden-source practices, and data-quality controls. Ability to understand financial instrument lifecycles and the downstream impact of data changes across trading, risk, operations, reporting, compliance, and client-facing workflows. Demonstrated experience working in Agile delivery environments, including Scrum ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning. Hands-on experience using Jira to create and manage epics, features, user stories, defects, workflows, dashboards, reports, and product backlogs. Ability to write clear, concise, and unambiguous user stories with detailed, testable acceptance criteria. Experience collaborating with technical teams and working knowledge of software-delivery concepts, including APIs, data integrations, system dependencies, testing, and production releases. Excellent stakeholder-management, communication, facilitation, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Ability to manage ambiguity, build alignment across cross-functional stakeholders, and maintain focus on delivering measurable customer and business value. We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective. Use of AI in Hiring As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration. jobDescription: At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. As a Senior Business Analyst on the Broadridge Revenue and Expense Management Solutions team, you are expected to be our regional support through the implementation and maintenance of the Revport application and its’ supporting modules. In this client facing, consultative role, you will be required to analyze and interpret internal and external business and technical requirements to build and deliver solutions to complex issues. Critical to success within this role is attention to detail, technically savvy, and a deep understanding of the Revport application and fee billing functions. Duties: Elicit and critically evaluate business and technical requirements. Come up with the solution/models which will full fill all end outputs for clients. Must have log term solution building vision and reduce manual steps. Triage issues and questions to determine root cause. Extract and integrate data for modeling and analysis to facilitate business planning decisions. Interpret data from multiple external sources and develop solutions which works on flexible data formats. Serve as a conduit to facilitate the flow of information between projects teams. Work with development, infrastructure, and analyst teams to execute against requirements. Confidence to raise the question and find the best approach for the task. Provide support, oversight, and SME knowledge to facilitate the growth of the project team. Qualifications and Competencies: Undergraduate (e.g., Bachelor’s) or graduate (e.g. MBA, Master’s) with an emphasis in finance, programming, or related quantitative field preferred. 3+ Years industry experience in one or more of the following: financial billing, Institutional, Mutual Funds, Capital Markets, Fund Accounting, Wealth. Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel and macros. Intermediate-advanced SQL and/or other programming a plus. Superb analytical skills and persistence in problem solving. Understanding of data, data flow, data enrichment and outputs. Demonstrate initiative and enthusiasm to learn and excel in a dynamic team. Requirements: Experience in using financial technology, application of quantitative methods or database administration. Experience analyzing business requirements and transforming them into technical designs. Experience with large/complex data sets Experience in analyzing and documenting requirements and system functional specifications including use cases. Preferred but not required, experience on Revport or any other billing system, to include Fi Serv Advantage, Quartal Fee Manager, or Redi2 Revenue Manager. title: AI Product Manager - Vice President
jobDescription:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. Key Responsibilities
1. Champion user-centric product development Stay closely connected to end users to deeply understand their needs, workflows, pain points, and goals. Translate user insights into clear product hypotheses and prioritized opportunities. Design and run lean experiments and A/B tests to validate product assumptions and measure impact. Foster a culture of user empathy and data-driven decision making within the product team. Iterate quickly based on user feedback and experiment outcomes to deliver meaningful improvements to the AI Platform.
2. Product Strategy and Vision Define and articulate the long-term vision for the AI Platform. Continuously scan the AI landscape for emerging trends, tools, and technologies (e.g., Gen AI, MLOps, LLMOps, Agentic AI) to ensure the platform remains best-in-class. Develop a forward-looking roadmap aligned with overall Broadridge Platform and AI strategy.
3. Roadmap and Backlog Management Identify core AI capabilities (predictive and generative AI, governance, etc.) that should be built, enhanced, or industrialized within the platform. Translate strategic initiatives into high level portfolio epics, steel threads and epics. Collaborate closely with Product Owner(s) to prioritize features and ensure sufficient well-groomed backlog runway. Build product mockups and prototypes to accelerate user feedback iteratively
4. Business Alignment and Use Case Enablement Partner with variety of stakeholders to gather requirements for AI Platform – these include i) business, product and engineering teams who want to build AI capabilities into the products, ii) innovation teams driving AI driven POCs, iii) transformation teams driving adoption of AI at scale. Serve as the internal ambassador for the AI platform, promoting its adoption and capabilities across the organization. Define and track key KPIs for platform usage, reliability, impact and NPS. Create alignment across stakeholders through clear communication and prioritization. Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field (MBA or advanced degree a plus). 6–10 years of experience in product management or technology strategy, with at least 3 years focusing on AI/ML platforms, data products, or enterprise platforms and products. Deep understanding of AI/ML life cycle (predictive and generative AI). Proven ability to lead global cross-functional teams through influence and thought leadership rather than authority. Experience engaging with technical teams and translating complex concepts for business stakeholders. Strategic mindset with the ability to connect emerging technology trends to business value. Experience building AI native solutions – agentic, machine learning, Gen AI Cloud architecture awareness: Knowledge of major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their AI/ML service offerings. Experience with modern MLOps / LLMOps tools and cloud AI platforms (e.g., AWS Sagemaker, Azure ML, Vertex AI). Familiarity with AI model architectures, LLMs, optimization techniques (prompting, fine-tuning), and AI frameworks. API and developer platform mindset: Understanding platform products, SDKs, and APIs that serve internal or external developers. Awareness of data architecture, data engineering and data management practices to enable AI at scale Strong understanding of responsible AI principles, governance, and compliance frameworks. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and storytelling skills. Experience delivering value using agile ways of working, lean principles and design thinking What You’ll Bring A passion for applying cutting-edge AI innovations responsibly and at scale. Ability to envision platform capabilities that transform business processes. A mindset that balances experimentation with execution discipline. title: Senior Business Analyst
jobDescription:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Trading Risk Support and Implementation Specialist to join our dynamic risk management team. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting trading risk processes, ensuring that trading systems and controls are aligned with regulatory requirements and best practices, and assisting with the implementation of risk management frameworks. You will work closely with traders, risk managers, IT teams, and other stakeholders to optimize the risk support functions and implement key risk controls. Experience: 3-6 Years Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Trading Risk Support: Monitor and manage risk metrics across multiple asset classes (equities, commodities, FX, etc.). Support traders and risk managers in ensuring that all trading activities comply with internal risk limits and regulatory requirements. Respond to queries related to risk limits, trading behavior, and operational issues, and work with internal teams to resolve discrepancies or issues. Assist in maintaining real-time risk reporting tools and dashboards for internal stakeholders. Provide post-trade risk analysis and support by ensuring the proper capture of trades in risk systems.
2. Implementation of Risk Controls: Collaborate with the risk management and technology teams to implement new risk management tools, systems, and controls. Assist in the design and deployment of risk policies, ensuring they are consistently followed across trading desks. Work on integrating new risk management features into the trading platform, ensuring smooth transitions from development to production environments. Participate in testing new risk tools and systems, performing validation of data and functionality before rollouts.
3. Risk Analysis and Reporting: Provide regular risk reports, analyzing risk exposures and assisting with the communication of risk insights to senior management and trading teams. Prepare detailed risk summaries and post-event analyses for major market movements or large trades. Contribute to the development of ad-hoc risk reports and dashboards, assisting in both internal and external audits.
4. Stakeholder Engagement & Training: Act as a liaison between the trading, technology, and risk teams to ensure effective communication and alignment on risk management issues. Provide training and guidance to junior team members and traders regarding risk controls and tools. Assist in preparing and reviewing risk documentation for regulatory reporting or internal audits.
5. Process Optimization: Continuously look for ways to improve risk management workflows and processes to increase efficiency and reduce operational risk. Participate in projects to enhance the risk management framework, ensuring the integration of best practices and industry standards.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Advanced degree (Master’s or CFA) or certification in risk management (FRM, PRM). Experience with risk system implementations or upgrades. Knowledge of relevant regulations (e.g., Dodd-Frank, Mi FID II, EMIR) and compliance requirements. Familiarity with market infrastructure and clearing systems. Skills & Competencies: Analytical Thinking: Ability to assess complex data, identify risk patterns, and develop actionable insights. Attention to Detail: Ability to spot inconsistencies and resolve them proactively. Problem Solving: Strong ability to think critically and solve problems under pressure. Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills to collaborate with stakeholders across multiple teams. Team-Oriented: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and build positive relationships across departments. We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Trading Risk Support and Implementation Specialist to join our dynamic risk management team. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting trading risk processes, ensuring that trading systems and controls are aligned with regulatory requirements and best practices, and assisting with the implementation of risk management frameworks. You will work closely with traders, risk managers, IT teams, and other stakeholders to optimize the risk support functions and implement key risk controls. Experience: 3-6 Years Key Responsibilities: 1. Trading Risk Support: Monitor and manage risk metrics across multiple asset classes (equities, commodities, FX, etc.). Support traders and risk managers in ensuring that all trading activities comply with internal risk limits and regulatory requirements. Respond to queries related to risk limits, trading behavior, and operational issues, and work with internal teams to resolve discrepancies or issues. Assist in maintaining real-time risk reporting tools and dashboards for internal stakeholders. Provide post-trade risk analysis and support by ensuring the proper capture of trades in risk systems. 2. Implementation of Risk Controls: Collaborate with the risk management and technology teams to implement new risk management tools, systems, and controls. Assist in the design and deployment of risk policies, ensuring they are consistently followed across trading desks. Work on integrating new risk management features into the trading platform, ensuring smooth transitions from development to production environments. Participate in testing new risk tools and systems, performing validation of data and functionality before rollouts. 3. Risk Analysis and Reporting: Provide regular risk reports, analyzing risk exposures and assisting with the communication of risk insights to senior management and trading teams. Prepare detailed risk summaries and post-event analyses for major market movements or large trades. Contribute to the development of ad-hoc risk reports and dashboards, assisting in both internal and external audits. 4. Stakeholder Engagement & Training: Act as a liaison between the trading, technology, and risk teams to ensure effective communication and alignment on risk management issues. Provide training and guidance to junior team members and traders regarding risk controls and tools. Assist in preparing and reviewing risk documentation for regulatory reporting or internal audits. 5. Process Optimization: Continuously look for ways to improve risk management workflows and processes to increase efficiency and reduce operational risk. Participate in projects to enhance the risk management framework, ensuring the integration of best practices and industry standards. Knowledge of relevant regulations (e.g., Dodd-Frank, MiFID II, EMIR) and compliance requirements. Familiarity with market infrastructure and clearing systems. title: Senior Anaplan Model Builder
jobDescription:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. About Broadridge Broadridge, a global fintech leader with 50 years in revenue, helps clients get ahead of today’s challenges to capitalize on what’s next with communications, technology and data and analytics solutions that help transform their businesses. The world’s leading companies and financial institutions recognize us as an invaluable partner. We handle millions of trades a day, touching trillions of dollars, deliver essential communications for over 5,000 brands and manage shareholder voting in 90 countries. Basic Purpose: Broadridge is seeking a Senior Anaplan Model Builder to support the Finance team. In this high-visibility role with strong growth potential, the Senior Anaplan Model Builder will partner with stakeholders at all levels of the organization and play a critical role in the development, execution, and continuous improvement of Broadridge’s FP&A Connected Planning application. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership skills, an entrepreneurial mindset, and a passion for helping build and scale Broadridge’s growing Anaplan team. Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead the design, development, and enhancement of complex Anaplan models across multiple business functions. Own end-to-end solution architecture, including data flows, calculations, security, and reporting. Translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable Anaplan solutions. Drive model optimization, performance tuning, and adherence to Anaplan best practices. Lead requirements workshops, design discussions, and solution walkthroughs with business and technical stakeholders. Review deliverables from other model builders to ensure quality, consistency, and design integrity. Mentor junior team members and provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing. Support testing, deployment, cutover, hypercare, and production issue resolution. Maintain documentation, governance standards, and solution controls across the Anaplan landscape. Partner with program and business leaders to prioritize enhancements and manage delivery timelines.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field. 5
- 8 years of experience in Anaplan or enterprise planning solution delivery. Anaplan Certified Model Builder with 3 to 5 end-to-end Anaplan Agile implementation projects. Strong hands-on experience with advanced Anaplan model building, design patterns, optimization, and troubleshooting. Proven ability to lead solution design and deliver complex, multi-dimensional planning models. Experience working directly with senior business stakeholders and translating strategic needs into technical solutions. Strong understanding of financial planning, operational planning, forecasting, and reporting. Ability to mentor team members and provide technical leadership. Experience with Oracle Cloud ERP, AWS, Snowflake, and/or Power BI is a plus. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective. jobDescription:

This means you will bring new technology to the organization and help to implement and then operationalize it. . You will also form last line of defense for major incidents and help prevent outages, You will with environments on-premise, in IBM Cloud and AWS. Part of your role will be to collaborate and help supervise our technology partners, vendors, managed service providers. What you will do Design, deploy, and administer Windows based infrastructure Input into Windows platform strategy and infrastructure roadmap Prepare project plans, provide estimates for project tasks, and assist with prioritization in relation to capacity planning and performance analytics. Collaborate with vendors, manage service providers and colleagues. Oversee operations, establish process and standard operating procedures Be the last line defense and escalation point for high severity production incidents Build OS images, patch bundles, scripts and automation Build CI/CD Pipelines Write code in Power Shell, Python/Ruby/Go and desired state for Chef/Ansible Working Environment: Fully Remote (in the US) or hybrid in NYC Metro New team in a new engineering function. Plan for unexpected and for opportunities to set standards / policies. Also plan for frequent involvement in day-to-day incidents (operations) until you mature the environment. Global organization with colleagues from overseas and work engagements outside of core business hours Basic Qualifications 5+ years in a similar role Ability to clearly communicate orally and in writing with engineers, vendors, managers, business, clients.
